name: Checkers 2P Entangled Convergence
description: Mathematically prove zero-drift state convergence across two separate Wasm guest linear memories over 6 opening moves via broker relay

steps.desc: Ensure vm-01 (Seat P1) is initialized at 390×844 Mobile Portrait
Ensure vm-02 (Seat P2) is initialized at 390×844 Mobile Portrait
Enable side-by-side split view mode
Open Checkers on vm-01 (Seat P1)
Open Checkers on vm-02 (Seat P2)
Configure vm-01 as Seat P1 on 2P Match #201
Configure vm-02 as Seat P2 on 2P Match #201
Assert vm-01 initial turn is Seat P1 (Red)
Assert vm-02 initial turn is Seat P1 (Red)
Assert initial state hashes of vm-01 and vm-02 match exactly
P1 (vm-01): Select piece at square 22 (PDN 23)
P1 (vm-01): Play move 22-18 (PDN 23-19)
Assert causal convergence: vm-02 state hash matches vm-01 after Move 1
Assert turn passed to Seat P2 (Black) on vm-02
P2 (vm-02): Select piece at square 10 (PDN 11)
P2 (vm-02): Play move 10-14 (PDN 11-15)
Assert causal convergence: vm-01 state hash matches vm-02 after Move 2
Assert turn passed back to Seat P1 (Red) on vm-01
P1 (vm-01): Select piece at square 18 (PDN 19)
P1 (vm-01): Play move 18-15 (PDN 19-16)
Assert causal convergence: vm-02 state hash matches vm-01 after Move 3
P2 (vm-02): Select piece at square 11 (PDN 12)
P2 (vm-02): Play capture jump 11x18 (PDN 12x19)
Assert causal convergence: vm-01 state hash matches vm-02 after Move 4 jump
P1 (vm-01): Select piece at square 20 (PDN 21)
P1 (vm-01): Play move 20-16 (PDN 21-17)
Assert causal convergence: vm-02 state hash matches vm-01 after Move 5
P2 (vm-02): Select piece at square 6 (PDN 7)
P2 (vm-02): Play move 6-10 (PDN 7-11)
Assert causal convergence: vm-01 and vm-02 converge to 100% identical hash after 6 moves
